title: Centre, Radius and Time: A Comparative Mathematical Process Across Circular Geometry, Navier-Stokes Dynamics and OpenAI's Published Blow-Up Construction
description:
An interdisciplinary public-review research note comparing circular geometry, Navier-Stokes similarity variables and OpenAI's published blow-up construction. It separates source mathematics, independently checked algebra, comparative interpretation and an unverified centre-outward time hypothesis.

This release does not claim a new Navier-Stokes proof, resolution of the unforced Clay Millennium problem, peer review, or physical validation of a theory of time.
notes: Mixed licensing applies: CC BY 4.0 for the paper, figures and AQDS-authored evidence; MIT for the original scripts. Helios AI assistance is disclosed in the paper and repository but is not listed as a formal creator or contributor.
